description: VDL2 on 136.725 / 136.875 / 136.975 MHz in one 2.048 Msps RTL-SDR capture centred on 136.650 MHz: both channels of the real pyVDL2 recording (each shifted to its own frequency and band-limited) and the synthetic dumpvdl2 test burst. The three frequencies fit one dumpvdl2 channel request (span midpoint 136.850 MHz).

Its bursts sit at -10.45 kHz (2.58, 5.50, 8.20 s) and +39.74 kHz (2.78, 3.02, 6.04 s) from the file's 0 Hz.
